appearances.snippet: UFO writes, 'Erika Frantzve continues to expose herself. She's desperate. Andrew (Andrew Wilson) ... Ashtray (Andrew Wilson) gained traction after you humiliated him, and he's now quickly losing it. He's a low-life grifter. Everybody can see that.' It's—it's not helpful for them, helpful to them, to—to give him anything. Just give it to a respectable journalist. This is bonkers that they're doing this. And, like I said, it shows that they want some legal distance. That's how I read it.
